title: Demo Engineer
description:
**About the role**


Rocketlane is building a dedicated Demo Engineering function \- and this is the founding role. As a Demo Engineer, you own the demo infrastructure that powers how Rocketlane shows up in every prospect conversation. You're not just supporting a sales process; you're engineering the product experience that makes or breaks a deal.


**What you'll build and own**


* A library of demo environments across segments, personas, and use cases \- always clean, always current, always deal\-ready
* POC environments for enterprise and mid\-market evaluations, configured to mirror real customer scenarios
* Nitro (AI agent) demo flows \- you'll be the first person to productize how Rocketlane's AI capabilities are shown to the market
* Segment\-specific variants (e.g. IT services vs. SaaS implementation teams) so every demo feels purpose\-built
* A documentation system for demo configs, data scripts, and setup guides \- so the infrastructure scales beyond you
* A feedback loop back to product \- you'll be closest to where the product meets the prospect, and that signal matters

**What you bring**


* Strong grasp of data, logic, and how software systems work
* Comfortable writing lightweight scripts or code (Python, JS, etc.)
* Detail\-oriented \- you notice when something looks off and you fix it
* Ramps quickly on new products and can map features to real\-world use cases instinctively
* 0–1 year of experience in a dev, QA, implementation, or similar technical role; strong fresh grads/interns welcome
* Bonus: exposure to PSA, PM tools, or platforms like Salesforce, Jira, or similar

**How you'll grow**


This is a new function at Rocketlane \- which means you're not walking into a defined box. You'll have direct visibility with the SE lead, product, and engineering. As Rocketlane scales, so does this function \- Demo Ops, Technical Enablement, or Solutions Engineering are all natural next chapters. And given you'll be building Nitro's demo motion from the ground up, you'll have a front\-row seat to how an AI product goes to market.


**You'll thrive here if you're**


A builder who takes ownership seriously. You see a broken demo environment as *your* problem to fix, not someone else's to report. You're curious about AI, care about craft, and want to build something that didn't exist before.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
**Customer Engineer — Rocketlane**


**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing SaaS company redefining how professional services teams


deliver customer projects. We recently raised $60M in Series C led by Insight Partners,


bringing total funding to over $105M from investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and


Nexus Venture Partners. With Nitro, our agentic execution platform, we've built an


AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and


surfaces delivery risks, right inside customer project workflows. We're 200\+ people building a


product that services teams love, and we're just getting started.


**What will you do?**


As a Customer Engineer, you'll be the hands\-on technical engine behind how our customers


connect Rocketlane to the rest of their tech stack. Working alongside FDEs, implementation


teams, and Product Managers, you'll spend your time understanding a customer's tools,


platforms, and data, and then building the pipelines and integrations that make everything


talk to each other.


This is a Customer Engineering role where you won't be expected to run enterprise accounts


solo on day one. Instead, you'll join client calls, learn to read a customer's technology


ecosystem quickly, and take ownership of well\-scoped engineering work: data models,


integrations, scripts, and connectors. Over time, as your judgment and customer instincts


grow, you'll take on bigger pieces of the deployment and start feeding what you learn in the


field back into the product.


**You don't need prior work experience to be great at this role.** If your final\-year project, a


hackathon build, or a personal side project involved wiring systems together, wrangling


messy data, or building something people actually used — that's exactly the muscle this role


needs. If you love writing code and being close to the customer, and "pure backend


engineer" feels too far from the people using what you build, this role is for you.**What you'll be responsible for**


**Data engineering across the customer's stack**


Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations that connect Rocketlane with the


tools our customers already use (CRM, HRMS, ERP, finance tools, data warehouses,


internal APIs).


Model and shape messy, real\-world customer data so it's clean and usable in


production.


Write Python scripts and small utilities to move, transform, and validate data between


systems.


**Understanding the customer's technology ecosystem**


Learn how each customer's platforms, tools, and data fit together, and translate that


into a clear picture the team can build against.


Join technical discovery and working sessions with senior FDEs — listening, asking


sharp questions, and gradually taking on more of the conversation.


**Hands\-on engineering with AI**


Work with LLMs to build customer\-specific automations: from simple prompt\-driven


scripts to connecting Nitro agents to customer data.


Debug integration and data issues, do root\-cause analysis, and ship fixes quickly —


with support from senior team members while you're ramping up.


**Contributing back to the product**


Surface recurring customer patterns, edge cases, and gaps to Product and


Engineering.


Help build reusable templates, connectors, and internal tooling so each deployment


makes the next one faster.


**Must\-have skills**


**0–3 years of software development experience, or strong, demonstrable**


**project experience** (final\-year projects, internships, hackathons, or open\-source


work) — comfortable writing clean Python.


Solid grasp of **data structures, data modeling, and databases** — coursework or


project\-level SQL and an understanding of how data flows between systems is


enough.


Comfortable reading and working with **REST APIs**: testing endpoints, understanding


auth, and wiring up integrations — even if this was only done in a class project or


personal build.


Some hands\-on exposure to **LLMs**: prompting, calling model APIs, or building small


AI\-powered tools — a weekend project counts.


Genuine interest in the customer side: the confidence to be on client calls, ask good


questions, and explain technical things clearly — think: explaining your project to a


professor outside your specialization, or to judges at a hackathon.


A bias toward action — your project history should show you dug into problems on


your own rather than only completing assigned coursework.


**Good\-to\-have skills**


Experience with ETL / data pipeline tools or integration platforms (Make, Workato,


Boomi, or similar) — academic or self\-taught exposure counts.


Familiarity with AI\-assisted dev tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, etc.).


Exposure to cloud (AWS/GCP), Postman, Docker, or webhooks — free\-tier or


personal\-project experience is fine.


Any internship, coursework, or project experience in a customer\-facing or B2B SaaS


setting.


A GitHub, portfolio, or demo link for your best project — we'd genuinely like to see


what you've built.


**You should apply if you**


Want to build real things that go live in customer environments in weeks, not


quarters.


Enjoy the mix of writing code and being in the room with customers.


Are early in your career — including brand new to the workforce — but hungry to


grow fast into a full Forward Deployed / Customer Engineer.


**Why join us?**


**Impact and ownership from day one** — small team, real problems, your work in


production.


**Learn from the best** — you'll be mentored by senior FDEs and see how enterprise


deployments actually work.


**Front\-row seat to the AI era** — build with frontier models and deploy real agents


into real businesses.


**Best\-in\-class benefits** — comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and


support for you and your family.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
#### **About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.


Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.


We’re a close\-knit team of over 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fuelled by $105M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.
  

  

**Profile Overview**  

  

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own the systems and data infrastructure that power Rocketlane's go\-to\-market engine. This role sits at the center of our sales and pipe gen tech stack \- CRM, outbound tooling, inbound routers, PRM, and the integrations that connect them. You'll be the person who makes sure data flows cleanly across systems, the right accounts get in front of the right reps, and decisions like territory planning and account scoring are backed by a clean, well\-structured data model. You'll work closely with Revenue, and Pipe Gen leaders. Your mission: keep the GTM tech stack running as one coherent system instead of a pile of disconnected tools, and make sure territory planning, routing, and account scoring sit on solid foundations. Expect high ownership, deep systems/API work, and close partnership with pipe gen leaders on experiments.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


* Own the CRM end\-to\-end: data model, structure, hygiene, and scalability as the sales org grows
* Own the broader sales/pipe gen tech stack: outbound tech stack, inbound routers, PRM, and related systems
* Build seamless integrations across systems: data sync, alerts, and workflows that just work
* Own territory planning: the single most important strategic initiative for a fast\-growing sales org
* Codify our ICP into account scoring and prioritization models
* Build and maintain lists for outbound and experiments using modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, etc.)
* Be a thought partner to pipe gen leaders: help design and run experiments, and support on the GTM engineering side
* Provide general support to sales and pipe gen teams (lowest priority \- this is a builder seat, not a ticket queue)

  

**What We're Looking For**


* 2 to 6 years of experience in RevOps, sales ops, or marketing ops (not an LDR/SDR or MRE\-to\-ops path)
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot/Salesforce: comfortable inside the CRM's data model, not just its UI
* Experience building lists with modern GTM tooling (Clay, Bitscale, or similar)
* Solid understanding of integrations, APIs, and tokens: you're comfortable wiring systems together, not just using them
* Data and BI tools experience is a plus
* Strong process thinker with an eye for efficiency, and a builder mindset
* Good with numbers, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail \- you spot trends, catch errors, and back decisions with data
* Clear communicator who can bridge business needs and system design
* High ownership operator who thrives in fast\-paced environments
* Curious about the latest in GTM tooling, especially AI and automation across the sales/pipeline stack

#### **Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company redefining how professional services teams deliver customer projects. We recently raised **$60M in Series C funding led by Insight Partners**, bringing our total funding to over $105M from top investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, along with super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg.


Our mission? To move the professional services industry from tracking work to *executing it*. With **Nitro**, our agentic execution platform, we've built the industry's first AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and surfaces delivery risks \- directly inside customer project workflows. We're a team of 200\+ passionate folks building a product that services teams love, and we're just getting started on the Outcome Era.


**What will you do? (Role Overview)**
-------------------------------------


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** on Rocketlane's AI Implementation team, you will own the technical success of our strategic customers as they adopt **Nitro AI agents**. You'll embed with customer teams \- running discovery, designing agent workflows, configuring integrations, engineering prompts, and shipping production\-grade apps and agents that drive measurable outcomes.


This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll understand customer workflows, orchestrate agents, write code debug live issues, and translate what you learn in the field into product improvements that shape the future of Nitro. If "professional services consultant" feels too removed from the keyboard and "pure product engineer" feels too removed from the customer, this role is built for you.


You'll be a founding member of our AI\-first Professional Services org \- someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving puzzles, and is energized by seeing their work live in production within weeks, not quarters.


**What You'll Be Responsible For**
----------------------------------


### **Customer\-Embedded Agent Deployment**


* Own end\-to\-end deployment of Nitro AI agents for enterprise customers \- from discovery and solution design to configuration, go\-live, and ongoing optimization.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (Services leaders, IT, Operations, Revenue teams) to map business workflows to Nitro agent capabilities.
* Design agent architectures that solve real delivery problems: migration agents, workforce agents, documentation agents and custom workflows tailored to each customer's environment.
* Build and deploy custom integrations between Nitro and customer systems (CRM, HRMS, ERP, Finance tools, data warehouses, internal APIs).

### **Hands\-On Engineering**


* Write production\-grade code/ scripts to extend, customize, or integrate Nitro agents into customer workflows.
* Engineer prompts, design evaluation frameworks, and tune agent behavior for customer\-specific data, terminology, and edge cases.
* Build data pipelines and connectors to feed agents with the right context \- SOWs, project history, customer communications, and structured delivery data.
* Debug live agent behavior in customer environments, perform root\-cause analysis on complex system interactions, and ship fixes fast.

### **Trusted Technical Advisor**


* Serve as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts throughout their Nitro implementation journey.
* Guide customers toward best\-practice implementations \- and push back when needed. Your job is to advise, not just execute requirements.
* Translate customer pain into clear problem statements, then into shipped solutions. Our model is simple: spend time understanding customer workflows, then build agents.

### **Product Feedback Loop**


* Be the voice of the customer inside Rocketlane. Surface patterns, edge cases, and feature gaps to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Prototype and validate new agent capabilities in the field before they become full product investments.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reusable agent templates, and scaled enablement content so every FDE engagement makes the next one faster.

### **Pre\-Sales \& POC Support**


* Partner with Sales and Solutions teams on high\-stakes enterprise deals \- building rapid POCs, running technical validations, and proving the business case for Nitro.
* Represent Rocketlane's technical depth in customer executive conversations, demos, and architecture reviews.

**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------


### **Engineering \& Technical Depth**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on software engineering/product management experience**, with the ability to write production\-grade code in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
* Strong command of **REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/auth flows, and enterprise integration patterns** \- you can read API docs, test endpoints, and ship integrations without hand\-holding.
* Good understanding of **data modeling and ETL** \- comfortable working with messy enterprise data and shaping it for production use.
* Comfortable with modern cloud, DevOps, and integration tooling (Postman, AWS/GCP, Docker, iPaaS platforms like Workato/Boomi/Make).

### **AI \& Agent Engineering**


* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI agent frameworks** \- prompt engineering, agent orchestration and evaluation/guardrails.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar) to move faster and build utilities that make deployments scalable.
* Strong intuition for when to use an agent vs. deterministic automation, and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that customers trust.

### **Customer\-Facing Instincts**


* 1\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role \- Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or similar at a B2B SaaS or AI company.
* Proven ability to drive enterprise deployments end\-to\-end with minimal supervision, including discovery, solutioning, and leading technical conversations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication \- you can sit in a room with a VP of Services and earn their trust, then turn around and write clean technical documentation.
* Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders

### **Problem\-Solving \& Ownership**


* **Bias toward action and ownership.** You see a problem, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.
* Strong first\-principles thinking \- you can decompose a messy customer problem into a solvable, shippable plan.
* Thrives in ambiguity. Comfortable operating without a playbook, because you're often the one writing it.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-------------------------


* Experience with **Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools** \- Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA, Kantata, etc.
* Background in **Professional Services, Customer Success Engineering, or technical implementation** at enterprise SaaS companies.
* Prior exposure to building or deploying **agentic AI systems** in production at an AI\-native or AI\-forward company.

**You Should Apply If You:**
----------------------------


* Want to be at the frontline of deploying real, production AI agents that change how businesses operate \- not just build another chatbot.
* Love owning customer outcomes end\-to\-end and thrive on the blend of engineering and customer conversations.
* Get energized by solving puzzles in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written.
* Are driven by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales \- and want to help define what "Forward Deployed Engineer" means at Rocketlane.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


At Rocketlane, we're all about building a great product *and* a great place to work. Here's why you'll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership:** You won't just be another cog in the machine; here, you're more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best:** We're a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins:** Whether we're hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow:** We're all about learning \- and not just the latest SaaS trends. You'll grow your career, pick up new skills, and work on problems that most engineers only read about.
* **Front\-row seat to the AI era:** You'll build with frontier models, deploy real agents into real enterprises, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes in weeks.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and benefits designed to support you and your family.

title: Security Detection Engineer
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands.**


**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**  

  

**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**  

  

**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**  

  

**For more information, visit** **WPP.com.**

  


**Why we're hiring:**



Detection Engineering is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high\-fidelity detection logic across enterprise security platforms. This role focuses on proactive threat detection, automation\-first practices, and continuous improvement of detection coverage and accuracy, supporting the WPP SOC transformation into an Autonomic Security Operations model.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Develop, test, and maintain detection rules and logic across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Regularly review and enhance detection logic to improve accuracy, reduce noise, and align with evolving threats.
* Work with wider WPP engineering teams to ensure high\-quality, normalized telemetry for effective detection.
* Automate detection rule deployment, QA, and version control using scripting and CI/CD pipelines.


**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**


* Conduct RCA on missed detections, delayed responses, and high\-severity incidents.
* Identify technical and process\-level causes of detection failures or inefficiencies.
* Drive corrective actions based on RCA outcomes (e.g., rule improvements, visibility gaps).
* Continuous Security Improvement (CSI)
* Maintain a CSI backlog (detection gaps, telemetry blind spots, false positives to reduce).
* Analyze detection performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Align detection priorities with business risk and the SOC transformation roadmap.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration
* Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Hunting teams to operationalize detection improvements.
* Work with Threat Intelligence teams to integrate emerging TTPs into detection logic.
* Contribute to purple team exercises by validating detection logic against simulated attack paths.


**Strategic Alignment to GCAT SOC10x**


* 10X People: Continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team.
* 10X Process: Embed agile workflows and automation\-first principles.
* 10X Technology: Leverage AI/ML for detection tuning and anomaly detectio.
* 10X Visibility: Ensure comprehensive telemetry ingestion and observability.
* 10X Speed: Reduce detection\-to\-response cycle through orchestration and automation.


**What you'll need:**


**Technical Expertise**


* Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms.

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III to join our CloudOps team, supporting managed cloud infrastructure for our enterprise customers on AWS. This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high\-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.

You'll combine hands\-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.
### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments.
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high\-severity issues, producing clear write\-ups and remediation actions.
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt.

### **Communication \& stakeholder management:**

* Communicate clearly and confidently with customers, Professional Services, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
* Plan, schedule, and run operational and governance meetings — setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions to completion.
* Provide regular, well\-structured status updates and reporting back to the wider CloudOps team, keeping colleagues informed of progress, risks, and changes.
* Represent CloudOps professionally in customer\-facing forums, translating technical detail into clear, actionable communication for a range of audiences.

### **Requirements :**

* Significant experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally within AWS environments.
* Strong working knowledge of core AWS services (e.g. EC2, RDS) and cloud infrastructure operations.
* Experience with monitoring/observability tooling, incident management, and change management processes.
* Understanding of security patching and compliance/audit processes (e.g. SOC 2\).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead meetings and communicate outcomes back to the team and to customers.
* Strong organisational skills and the proven ability to manage competing priorities under your own initiative.
* A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable working independently and knowing when to seek support from the team.
* Relevant AWS certification(s) desirable.

* Cultivates Innovation
* Decision Quality
* Manages Complexity
* Drives Results

title: Sailpoint
description:
**Role description**  


Role Summary


The SailPoint IAM Platform Engineer will design, integrate, administer, secure, and support the SailPoint identity platform and its connected enterprise applications. The role combines application onboarding, identity lifecycle automation, Linux and application\-server administration, vulnerability mitigation, high availability, disaster recovery, and audit support. The engineer will help ensure reliable provisioning and deprovisioning, least\-privilege access, secure connectivity, and timely access revocation for employees, contractors, and third\-party users.


Key Responsibilities


1\. SailPoint Integration \& Application Onboarding


* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding and integration of enterprise applications into SailPoint IAM.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, account correlation, access profiles, entitlements, provisioning, deprovisioning, and reconciliation.
* Partner with application owners, HR, infrastructure, security, and audit teams to capture requirements, define controls, test integrations, and transition solutions into production.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
2\. Enterprise Systems in Scope


* WMS and workforce or warehouse management systems.
* SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* Master Data Management platforms.
* Active Directory and LDAP directories.
* Electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign and Adobe Acrobat Sign.
* HR platforms and other authoritative sources that trigger identity lifecycle events.
3\. Identity Lifecycle \& Process Enhancement


* Design, enhance, and streamline identity lifecycle processes for joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, and third\-party users.
* Integrate SailPoint with HR systems and authoritative sources to trigger lifecycle events accurately and consistently.
* Automate access provisioning and deprovisioning in line with least\-privilege principles and approved access policies.
* Ensure timely revocation of access for leavers, terminated personnel, and expired contractors.
* Continuously fine\-tune workflows, rules, approvals, exception handling, and operational controls to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.
4\. Linux \& SailPoint Platform Administration


* Administer Linux environments, with strong hands\-on expertise in Oracle Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
* Manage SailPoint application servers and Tomcat, including JVM tuning, service configuration, performance optimization, and log management.
* Perform operating\-system\-level troubleshooting, capacity monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and performance tuning.
* Administer file systems, permissions, scheduled jobs and cron jobs, system services, and platform certificates.
* Maintain secure communication between SailPoint and connected target systems.
5\. Vulnerability Mitigation, Security \& Compliance


* Review and remediate vulnerabilities identified through OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* Plan and apply SailPoint patches, hotfixes, and third\-party library upgrades using controlled change and validation procedures.
* Perform operating\-system hardening aligned with applicable CIS Benchmarks and organizational security standards.
* Manage TLS/SSL certificates, keystores, truststores, renewals, and certificate\-related incident resolution.
* Support ISO, SOC, internal security, and customer audit reviews by providing evidence, remediation updates, and control documentation.
* Follow security, change, incident, problem, and release management practices.
6\. High Availability, Resilience \& Disaster Recovery


* Configure, operate, and support SailPoint high\-availability architecture hosted in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Manage clustering, load balancing, node health, failover behavior, and availability monitoring.
* Coordinate disaster recovery activities, recovery validation, and periodic failover testing.
* Monitor platform health, availability, performance, interfaces, queues, logs, and scheduled jobs; take proactive corrective action.
* Participate in production support, major incident resolution, and after\-hours support as required by the operating model.
Required Skills \& Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience with SailPoint application integration, connector configuration, application onboarding, and identity lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience administering enterprise SailPoint environments and supporting production operations.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, particularly Oracle Linux and RHEL.
* Hands\-on experience with Tomcat administration, JVM tuning, log analysis, certificate management, file systems, and cron scheduling.
* Experience remediating infrastructure and application vulnerabilities using OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with HA, clustering, load balancing, failover, disaster recovery, and health monitoring in OCI or a comparable cloud environment.
* Working knowledge of IAM principles, least privilege, access governance, segregation of duties, provisioning, deprovisioning, and audit controls.
* Integration experience with HR systems, Active Directory/LDAP, SAP, MDM, WMS, and SaaS applications through standard connectors, APIs, or secure file interfaces.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and production\-support skills.
Education \& Certification


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Professional credential or SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer certification is required or strongly preferred, based on the final hiring level.
* Additional Linux, cloud, security, ITIL, or IAM certifications are advantageous.
Preferred Technical Exposure


* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and/or IdentityIQ.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Linux shell scripting, REST APIs, web services, JDBC, SCIM, and directory integrations.
* Monitoring, ticketing, source control, CI/CD, and enterprise change\-management tools.
* Security baselines, vulnerability management, certificate lifecycle management, and compliance evidence preparation.
Key Competencies


* Ownership and accountability for platform reliability and secure operations.
* Structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Risk awareness and disciplined change execution.
* Collaboration across HR, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, and audit teams.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and operational resilience.

CFD  

1\. Specializing in thermal simulations including fluid flow, heat transfer, multiphase flow and related engineering problems.

3\. Expertise in active and passive cooling systems to meet thermal criteria across applications.  

4\. Applications include data centers, telecommunication devices, storage devices, energy storage systems, thermostats \& display systems in medical devices and navigation systems in marine vehicles (heat dissipation ranges from 20W to 4kW or more).  

5\. Lead the development and implementation of thermal and mechanical requirements for server platform systems ranging from 1U to 10U form factors.  

6\. Conduct extensive thermal simulations using CFD tools on PCle and custom form factor circuit cards to verify designs: Generation of thermal curves to qualify thermal level of PCIe Cards.  

7\. Participate in thermal technology research and development to meet the thermal requirements of future IT equipments.  

8\. Executed estimation of material properties for efficient heat dissipation by mechanical testing, thermal testing, and surface testing and intrinsic transient testing; diagnosis of DoE and failure analysis based on CTQ specifications.  

9\. Thermal test validation of IT equipment including server/storage/switch product as per international standards.  

10\. Exhibit key DRC, LVS \& footprint and GERBER validation: Adopt thermal design for PCB placement and routing optimization as per the thermal simulations.  

11\. Drive fan tuning and system thermal optimization efforts.  

12\. Capability to analyze and reduce the system noise inside the enclosures by simulation output.  

13\. Knowledge on IP ratings of enclosures.


FEA


1\. Specializing in both Static and Dynamic Analysis, encompassing Shock, Vibration, Seismic, and Drop Testing.  

2\. Experience in physical testing of data center racks (various ranges up to 52U height) such as payload, tilt, impact and drop tests.  

3\. Experience in performing Seismic (Dynamic) analysis to meet the GR\-63 standards for indoor enclosures at high seismic zone (Level 4\).  

4\. Strong expertise in performing dynamic shock analysis to qualify products for Operational shock (40G) and crash hazard shock (75G).  

5\. Capability to perform dynamic vibration analysis to evaluate product for random vibration (0 to 500Hz) and shipboard vibration (4 to 33Hz).  

6\. Experience in creation of optimal product design for suitable and cost\-effective products by structural analysis.  

7\. Knowledge on GR\-63 and MIL standards.  

8\. Capability to extract information about displacements, velocities, accelerations, joint reactions, and inertial loads of all the mechanism components, as well as the power necessary to sustain the motion.  

9\. Conduct interference checks in real time, and provides the exact spatial and time positions of all mechanism components as well as the exact interfering volumes.

* Experience in Solidworks Simulation and ANSYS Mechanical.
* Experience in Flotherm, Solidworks Flow Simulation and ANSYS Icepak.
* Expertise in active and passive cooling systems to meet thermal criteria across applications.
* Specializing in both Static and Dynamic Analysis, encompassing Shock, Vibration, Seismic, and Drop Testing.
* Specializing in thermal simulations including fluid flow, heat transfer, multiphase flow and related engineering problems.
* Expertise in data center cooling solutions designed to manage the intense thermal loads of AI infrastructure and high\-density servers.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market\-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high\-volume manufacturing.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

**Application Development Engineer**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Customer support** : Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head\-to\-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world\-wide customers. This includes\-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating \& sharing product value statements and use\-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* **Product Demonstration** : Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* **Product Characterization** : Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* **Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting** : Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* **Customer Relationship** : Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* **Training** : Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on\-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* **Documentation** : Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* **Presentation/Communication Skills** : Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.

**Requirements:**

* We are looking for high energy, self\-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  

  

  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a passionate **Quality Engineer** with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system\-level testing.
* Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity.
* Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift\-Left quality practices.
* Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis.
* Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics.
* Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release\-readiness initiatives.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Strong software development experience using **C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language** .
* Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure.
* Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI.
* Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG.
* Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web\-service technologies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on exposure to **Generative AI, AI\-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI** .
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years


**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  

  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  

  

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing

This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose\-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.


This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI\-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.




As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:

* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real\-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation \& Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.




If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.




**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and deliver implementation strategies for State of the Art (Gen)AI\-based Applications in manufacturing domain.
* Design and implement a Knowledge Transfer strategy to scale the own experience via a Growing and Ambitious AI Team.
* Drive technical innovation through boundary\-pushing experimentation, while maintaining alignment with customer commitments and delivery expectations.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations teams to design and integrate AI features into digital products.

* Mastery of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning algorithms as applied to manufacturing (predictive maintenance, defect detection, process automation).
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and common ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, JAX).
* Experience deploying production AI solutions (MLOps) with robust data pipelines, monitoring, retraining, and scalability in real factory settings.

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Prior experience in technical training, mentorship, or consulting role, preferably within a corporate or academic setting.
* Demonstratable experience with manufacturing data, industrial protocols, plant systems, and translating business goals into machine learning projects.
* Architected or deployed digital twin solutions for virtual representation of physical assets/processes.
* Experience working with knowledge graphs, graph databases, vector databases, manufacturing ontologies, and semantic models to improve contextual retrieval and reasoning.
* Experience optimizing AI applications for latency, throughput, token consumption, infrastructure utilization, and overall operating cost.




* Knowledge of integrating real\-time manufacturing data (IoT, PLC, MES/ERP connectivity) to digital twins for simulation and predictive analytics.

Strong problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering high\-quality architectural solutions that meet client needs and project objectives.  
* 

  

**Moving forward together**

  

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. title: AI Engineer
description:
GE Vernova’s Power Conversion \& Storage business is at the forefront of the energy transition. We are seeking several highly skilled AI Engineers to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI\-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision\-making across our business.
  

  

In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross\-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and machine learning to real\-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.
  

  

A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or pure software development when needed.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities**


**AI \& ML Solution Development \& Integration**


* Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.
* Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade\-offs behind that choice.
* Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.
* Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI\-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.
* Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.
  

  

**Technical Implementation \& Architecture**


* Collaborate with domain experts to identify high\-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.
* Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.
* Design cloud\-ready and on\-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data\-governance standards.
* Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development of robust, production\-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.
  

  

**Solution Delivery, Partner \& Contractor Management**


* Write clear technical specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria for work delivered by external contractors, software vendors, or internal digital teams.
* Contribute to supplier, platform, and tool selection through structured technical evaluation, benchmarking, and proof\-of\-concept comparison.
* Steer and review the work of internal \& external partners: technical follow\-up, design reviews, code and model reviews, quality gates, and acceptance testing; remaining the technical owner and guardian of the delivered solution.
* Ensure solutions remain maintainable after handover through documentation, knowledge transfer, and clearly assigned ownership, so that delivered tools do not become orphaned.
  

  

**Data Strategy \& Analytics**


* Lead or support the collection, processing, structuring, and analysis of large\-scale operational and business data.
* Assess data readiness ahead of any development (availability, quality, labelling needs, access rights, confidentiality) and define strategies to close the gaps.
* Identify patterns, trends, and performance improvement opportunities using advanced analytics and AI methods.
* Develop data\-driven solutions such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality and performance prediction, forecasting, cost analysis, document and requirement analysis, and knowledge support tools.
  

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with technical, operational, business and IT teams to ensure AI solutions meet business and industry requirements for safety, reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Help align AI initiatives with business priorities, operational goals, and constraints.
* Support end\-user adoption: training, onboarding, feedback loops and measurement of the benefits realized once the solution is live.
  

  

**Continuous Innovation**


* Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability.
* Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities.
* Maintain an active technology watch on the AI tooling landscape and filter it, distinguishing capability gains from hype before proposing adoption.
* Contribute to building an innovation\-oriented culture through knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  

  

  

**Education**


* Bachelor/Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  

  

**Experience**


* Several years (2 to 4\) of professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a comparable technical role.
* Experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in industrial, technical, or other complex operational environments is preferred.
  

  

**Technical Expertise**


* Strong programming skills in Python, C\+\+, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code.
* Hands\-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, as well as classical ML tooling (e.g. scikit\-learn, gradient boosting methods).
* Experience with time\-series analysis, optimization methods, and data\-driven model development.
* Practical experience with GenAI and their surrounding stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A)
* Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data.
* Solid grounding in cloud services and architecture (Azure, **AWS**)
* Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, data pipelines, and structured/unstructured data handling.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model deployment, and integration into production environments is an advantage.
  

  

**Domain Knowledge (Secondary)**


* Sound knowledge of artificial intelligence, combined with a strong interest in emerging technologies and digital trends.
* Understanding of industrial processes, electrification, power systems, or related technical domains, or business processes, is an advantage.
* Awareness of the regulatory and governance context around AI (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) is a plus.
* Experience in innovation management and/or patent\-related work is a plus.
  

  

**Personal Attributes**


* Proven ability to translate complex business and technical challenges into practical, scalable AI\-driven solutions.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with a high degree of self\-motivation and a structured, goal\-oriented working style.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across functions and disciplines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

Excellent analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**


Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing


We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing \& Supply Digital Platform—a next\-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.


This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose\-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.


This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI\-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.


As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:

* System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real\-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
* Automation \& Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
* Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.


If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead architectural design and development of generative/optimization models for process simulation, process scheduling, and predictive analytics in manufacturing.
* Orchestrate pipelines integrating synthetic data generation, model training, validation, and deployment.
* Implement advanced optimization: multi\-objective, non\-linear, evolutionary, and constraint\-based approaches for process efficiency (e.g., scheduling, logistics, yield predictions).
* Guide the integration of embedded AI \& Gen AI solutions with real\-time industrial data streams, ensuring high\-throughput, high\-availability, and low\-latency deployment.
* Mentor teams in coding best practices, simulation\-modelling, and deployment workflows using latest industrial AI stacks.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong experience with Generative AI models. Hands\-on experience with Amazon bedrock and AWS AI\-ML services
* Proficiency in building and managing Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen or similar.
* Expertise on cloud\-native architecture, LLMOps and MLOps tools.
* Familiarity with security, cost and governance best practices for Gen AI on cloud environments.

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Previous leadership in deploying ML pipelines and automation (CI/CD, containerization) at scale.
* Knowledge of quantization\-aware training, model pruning, and NVIDIA\-specific deployment tools (TensorRT, DeepStream SDK).
* Working knowledge of OpenUSD scene graphs, data schemas, and extension development for Omniverse Kit/Composer.
* Published research, open\-source contributions, or patents in simulation\-driven manufacturing AI or optimization.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA’s AI stack— RAPIDS, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, cuOpt (or similar)
* Applied industrial AI expertise: root\-cause analysis, predictive maintenance, digital twin calibration.

**Educational Background:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 7\-10 years of professional experience in associated field is required, a Master’s degree and 4\-6 years of experience, or a PhD and 1\-3 years of experience in relevant field.


This position requires working onsite five days a week.
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:**


September 16, 2026 \- October 1, 2026
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

description:
